title: Arbor project
description: One project in the setup repo: projects/<owner>/<name>/project.json, or projects/_local/<name>/project.json for one with no remote. Beside it: instructions.md, machines/<machine>.md and skills/<skill>/. Move the folder under projects/_archive/ to keep it on record without syncing.

remote.description: The URL to clone, as git takes it. Its owner/name has to be the folder's. Not for a project in _local.

local.description: True for a project in _local. The folder is what counts.

path.description: Where it goes on every machine. Default <codeRoot>/<owner>/<name>, or <codeRoot>/_local/<name>.

branch.description: The branch kept up to date. Default the remote's.

machines.description: The machines it's on: "all", or each by name or @role with its values there. A machine's own entry wins over its role's.

path.description: Where it goes on this machine.

skills.description: On or off in each of its checkouts, over the machine's value.

plugins.description: On or off in each of its checkouts, by name@marketplace.

mcp.description: On or off in each of its checkouts.
